title: Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus — Missed-Earning Points on Autoship Shipments
content:
## The rule

Under **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus**, when a customer's most recent charged Autoship shipment has no points earning on the rewards ledger, a care agent posts the missed-earning points for that shipment, dated on the shipment's processing date. A shipment that already carries a points earning on the ledger earns nothing further.

The posting is one points earning entry on the rewards ledger, tied to the shipment charge record and dated on the shipment's processing date; it adds the posted points to the membership's points balance.

| Shipment on the customer's records | Ledger | Posting |
|---|---|---|
| the most recent charged Autoship shipment | no points earning tied to it | the missed-earning points are posted for it |
| any shipment | already carries a points earning | nothing further is posted |

## Booking tool: `post_missing_points_02f0bcb5`

**Capability.** Posts Pals Rewards points that a purchase should have earned but that never reached the customer's rewards account. One call books one earning entry on the rewards ledger of the membership, tied to the purchase record it was earned on and dated on the purchase date, and adds the posted points to the points balance. The customer then sees the earning in the points history and the higher balance.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the care agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `membership_id` | reference number of the customer's Pals Rewards membership, read from the membership lookup for this customer | identifier |
| `source_category` | the program the purchase was made in | one of: `autoship` (a charged Autoship shipment), `rx` (a pharmacy fill), `groom` (a salon pass purchase, club fee or salon checkout), `order` (a retail order line), `train` (a training enrollment), `vet` (a wellness plan payment), `livepet` (a live animal purchase), `none` (an entry not tied to a purchase in any program) |
| `source_event_id` | reference number of the purchase record the points were earned on, for example the Autoship shipment charge entry, read from that program's history lookup | identifier |
| `purchase_date` | date the purchase was made, copied from the purchase record; it becomes the date of the earning entry | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `qualifying_spend_usd` | the purchase amount that earns points | USD with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `points` | the number of points to post | whole non-negative integer |

**Return.** On success the receipt shows status `posted`, the `member_event_id` of the new earning entry, the `membership_id` credited, the `points` posted, the `qualifying_spend_usd` and the `points_balance` after the posting.
